args.title: Incident summary: double charge on retry
args.body: Maya identified the root cause of the double-charge incident as retry.py failing to carry the idempotency key across the second attempt, affecting roughly 40 orders per day. Jordan confirmed the behavior in staging and said the fix is to persist the idempotency key before the first capture, which is implemented in PR #481. Maya then asked for an issue to be filed in the payments-api repository so the work is tracked.
